data.name: Split Screen Shooter
data.detailed_description:
Nowdays its hard to find a normal split screen PVP/PVE shooter to casually play with your friends. Especially on PC. That's why I decided to make this. A by design generic shooter, reminisend of the classics from my time as a teenager.

Full split screen experience!

  • Game is designed from the ground up for local split screen!

  • You can play with controller and/or mouse and keyboard

  • We officially support up to 6 players

  • (Though you can theoretically go up to 9 players, with 8 controllers and 1 player with mouse and keyboard. But you will need a veeery beefy PC for that)

Play the way you want

  • Selection of the all the classic shooter weapons. Unlocked from the start

  • Small, but refined selection of attachments. No min-maxing, just the basics

  • Create custom classes and choose from Perks. They range from classics ... to more fun and exquisite ones

  • Play all the classic modes, FFA, TDM, CTF, Conquest and Defuse

  • Adjust the settings of each gamemode to your liking

  • Add global perks to the match, to modify and spice up your experience

  • Full bot support. Add up to 8 bots to any match. You can also play alone against bots.

Maps

Selection of 12 maps inspired by classic shooters set in the modern times. These vary in setting and size, so you have something fun, no matter the group size.

Additionally there will be 8 fun maps. They don't fit into the modern military theme at all, but who cares. You know when you joined a modded server and landed on a giantic map with you being the size of a rat? That's the kind of obsucre map you will find there.

Multi-screen Splitscreen

You can split the splitscreen onto multiple displays connected to the same PC. For example for a fair 1 vs 1 without screen-cheating. Or give a dedicated screen to each team.

Keep in mind that there is still only one audio output for all players, there is no individual sound.

While we aim to get as close as possible to the good old times of secretly playing shooters with your friends, some features from back then won't make it in. We are a very small, self funded team. Systems like Kill Streaks or Kill Cams won't make it into our game, due to time and budget reasons. And imho, as long as you can 1v1 quick scope, everythings fine!

data.short_description: It's 2009. You are at your bestfriends home, playing on the console of their big brother. A game you are too young to play, at a time where you should be doing your homework. Thats this game, a generic shooter, but split screen!
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Bulgarian, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Finnish, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Czech, Turkish, Ukrainian
